item.title: Friend medals say what you passed them in
item.summary: A Passed medal now names the exercise, friend boards show only people sharing that number, and Health charts show your saved history from before you joined.
item.details: Steps medals open your Steps on Health. Health now covers resting heart rate, steps and sleep; hours-slept totals and VO2 max are no longer medals. Friend boards load faster on Steps and Sleep.
